children: Saha takes charge as managing director and chief executive officer after overseeing retail banking, data analytics and marketing as whole-time director

Anup Kumar Saha has been elevated to Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer at Kotak Mahindra Bank, after serving as a Whole-Time Director with responsibility for retail banking, data analytics and marketing.

Saha joined Kotak Mahindra Bank in January 2026 and has been overseeing the three functions since March 2026. His career spans retail banking, consumer finance, structured finance and data-led businesses.
Saha has been part of the bank’s senior leadership since joining in January 2026. As Whole-Time Director, his remit has included retail banking, data analytics and marketing.
His elevation to MD and CEO comes within the same year of joining the bank, expanding his responsibilities across the organisation.
Before joining Kotak Mahindra Bank, Saha served as Managing Director at Bajaj Finserv, where he spent eight years.

During his tenure, he was involved in the expansion of the company’s consumer finance business. His experience there added to his background in retail-focused financial services and data-led businesses.
Saha spent 14 years at ICICI Bank before moving to Bajaj Finserv. During this period, he held senior leadership roles across retail and structured finance.

His career has therefore covered multiple areas of financial services, including retail banking, consumer finance and structured finance, alongside responsibilities involving data and business growth.
In his new role, Saha will lead Kotak Mahindra Bank after having already taken responsibility for key consumer-facing and data-oriented functions.
His appointment adds another phase to a career that has included senior roles at ICICI Bank and Bajaj Finserv before his move to Kotak Mahindra Bank in 2026.
Saha’s immediate leadership remit follows his recent experience overseeing retail banking, analytics and marketing at the bank.
